text:
Alex: Quick sync — peering + residency for eu-west-3. We need clear owners for peering, KMS, routing policy, and DB replica before we flip any traffic. Who can own what?

Maria: I can own the routing policy + firewall rules. Will open a PR today, ETA EOD.

Chen: I’ll take KMS (create keys + rotation). Quick question: are we using our CMK in our org or customer-managed keys for this region? That changes the IAM flow.

Sam: Infra side: I can own VPC/peering provisioning. Note that cloud provider requires a peering request from our account -> partner account; need a contact for that. Also we should restrict early traffic to non-PII canaries.

Alex: Plan proposal: 
1) Infra (peering/VPC) — Sam
2) Routing & ACLs — Maria
3) KMS — Chen
4) DB read-replica setup — engineering-db (need owner)
5) Canary routing (traffic-split + prod-block flag) — Alex/Platform
Milestones: prov by Thu, ACL PR by Fri, KMS keys by Fri EOD, canary next Tue.

Kati: Pinged Jules offline for DB replica ownership (he's out this morning). Will loop him in once he’s back.

Chen: Terraform snippet I'll use (will open PR):
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "eu_w3" {
  description = "eu-west-3 regional key for canary"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
  enable_key_rotation = true
}
```
I'll include the key policy that allows the routing service role.

Maria: Routing policy draft is in ops/routing repo, PR #312 (link: https://git.redwood/ops/routing/pulls/312). Goal: route eu-west-3 to regional pool, fallback to eu-west-1 if capacity < 20%. Also adding a "prod-block" flag for the canary so no prod tokens are admitted. Please review.

Sam: Infra notes: need the cloud-team bot approval for peering quota bump. I'll file the quota request now. VPC CIDR we propose: 10.40.0.0/16 to avoid overlap. Also will post the provision runbook to /runbooks/ew3-provision.md once staging run is green.

Alex: Can we start canary at 1% and hold for 24h metrics? If errors > 1% or latency increases > 50ms we rollback automatically. Also add token-cost metric to watch for regressions.

Maria: I'll add traffic-split to the routing PR and wire up the dashboard (latency, error_rate, token_cost). Pinged @dash-team to pre-create the dashboard templates.

Chen: KMS PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/789. PTAL @Alex @Sam. I added a note about cross-account grants if we go with customer CMKs.

deploy-bot: terraform plan for infra/ew3 completed — no changes to prod infra, plan shows new kms key + vpc. CI: ✅

Alex: Thanks all. Action items: Sam file quota request + prov; Maria finalize routing PR + prod-block; Chen merge KMS PR; Kati confirm DB owner and timeline. We'll do async check-in Friday 10am.

Maria: noted. I'll request reviews now. :thumbsup:
